milestone: 4a: a power cut drives a firm out of the district

tasks.goal: Fill in flee() in src/sim/economy.js: a firm gives up on a district a few seconds after a power cut ends, sized to how long it was dark.
tasks.commit: feat(economy): a power cut drives a firm out of the dark district
tasks.notes: Only the body of flee() changes; the comment above it is the exact rule. Remove the three void lines. Body: if (d.dark) d.darkFor += dt; else if (d.darkFor > 0) { d.fleeAt = economy.time + FLIGHT_SECS; d.fleeJobs = d.size * FLIGHT_PER_DARK_SEC * d.darkFor; d.darkFor = 0; } if (economy.time < d.fleeAt) return; const use = d.firms.com >= d.firms.ind ? 'com' : 'ind'; const jobs = Math.min(d.fleeJobs, d.firms[use]); d.firms[use] -= jobs; if (jobs > 0) d.last = { at: economy.time, use, jobs: -jobs, cause: 'dark' }; d.fleeAt = Infinity; Never call economy.rand in flee. Do not touch the constants, makeDistrict or tickEconomy. tests/economy.spec.js, tests/zoning.spec.js and tests/decline.spec.js must stay green.
